title: The cone on multiplication by a product is the cone of a map between the cones on the factors
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the cone on multiplication by a product of two ring elements as the cone of a map between the cones on the factors, and the proof is a 62-line argument that treats the case of the ring placed in degree zero first and then deduces the general case. In the special case it writes the map of complexes explicitly, identifies the differential of the cone with a two by two matrix whose entries are the two elements, and produces the two maps of complexes witnessing the homotopy equivalence, leaving the homotopy itself unwritten; in the general case it uses the compatibility of totalisation with homotopies and cones and the description of the cones as total complexes of double complexes, again leaving some details. Both the special case computation and the reduction are displayed.
